learningObjectives: Explain the purpose of React components and JSX.
Compose reusable interfaces from smaller components.
Identify the basic structure of a React application.

activities.title: React App Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the major parts of a React application.

content.concept: A React application is composed of components, JSX, application logic, and a rendering entry point.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: JSX Explorer
activities.instruction: Click JSX elements to identify their roles.

content.concept: JSX combines JavaScript expressions with HTML-like syntax to describe React interfaces.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component Composition
activities.instruction: Build a page by combining reusable components.

content.concept: Component composition allows complex interfaces to be constructed from smaller reusable components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: React Rendering Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of React rendering.

content.concept: React evaluates components and updates the rendered interface when relevant data changes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
